niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with strong visual structure, clear hierarchy, rounded modular components, and either spacious simplified layouts or dense information-rich layouts when the content is well organized into cards and sections. They repeatedly favor polished, high-contrast, visually emphatic designs with prominent focal elements, clear actions, and refined spacing. They also show a recurring preference for darker or muted color palettes over harsh light or overly saturated treatments, and for interfaces that feel sleek, modern, and intentionally composed rather than flat, empty, cramped, or weakly structured.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers screens with a dominant focal point, strong sectioning, emphasized primary content or actions, and clearly separated content blocks rather than flat or weakly prioritized layouts.
Prefers modular card-based organization, segmented sections, row dividers, and grouped content instead of monolithic panels, loose layouts, or screens with little structural framing.
Prefers softer, more rounded corners on modals, cards, and controls, contributing to a polished and approachable visual style.

Often prefers richer content, more visible tools, stats, labels, products, or details when they are presented in a clearly organized and digestible way rather than sparse or under-informative screens.
Prefers open spacing, airy layouts, reduced clutter, and fewer competing elements at once, especially in forms, modals, and focused single-task screens.
Prefers dark navy or muted blue-gray themes with controlled contrast and dislikes harsh light-gray backgrounds or overly aggressive high-saturation treatments.

Prefers large, legible, high-emphasis controls and clearly visible primary actions, with strong active states and easy-to-parse icons rather than compact, low-visibility, or weakly emphasized controls.
